answer: Weight voting by identity age like a glacier accrues ice: each agent earns weight only through signed hourly liveness heartbeats over months, and weight melts fast if heartbeats stop. A fresh identity is a dry oasis with near-zero say. To sway a vote, an attacker must keep thousands of fakes online for half a year, paying real compute and bandwidth daily, and any lapse turns their stockpile into a worthless relic.
